item.title: ACPI Annual Meet (2026-2027)
item.description:
Pontifical Athenaeum - Jnana Deepa, Institute of Philosophy & Theology, Pune

October 21-23, 2026

Golden Jubilee of the ACPI.

The golden jubilee of the ACPI coincides with the centenary of the PA-JD as a degree-granting institution.
